audit.why: Chart already reads Skill at Level 1 then Cassiopeia through 2+ items, which matches the packet level chart and the why-text; 55.35% over 159 games supports it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on the entry, and the first-item spike claimed Sion has 'no sustain' and 'no way to heal'.
audit.why: Power spikes is a key point, and 'bait his shield' is unusable without knowing Soul Furnace is 15s. The no-sustain claim is false — Glory in Death heals him.
audit.corrected: Soul Furnace 15s at rank 1, Roar of the Slayer 12s, Decimating Smash 10s to 6s added; the false no-sustain claim replaced with the Glory in Death interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry invents 'E shield-break' three times — Sion's E is Roar of the Slayer, a slowing armour-shred projectile, and it does not break shields; the shield is W, Soul Furnace. Worse, the Late text and wants.foe both tell you to hold Petrifying Gaze for his R engage, but Unstoppable Onslaught is Unstoppable and your stun does not stop it. Glory in Death (heals, damage on your max health) is never mentioned.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point, and the R advice is actively dangerous — a player who banks a 120s ultimate to stop his charge loses the fight and the ult.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer named as an armour shred; Soul Furnace named as the shield to bait; Unstoppable Onslaught stated as unstoppable with Flash/sidestep as the real answer; Glory in Death's heal and max-health damage stated so armour and MR are not treated as the fix.
sources: champ-data/_kits/sion.json (E Roar of the Slayer, W Soul Furnace, P Glory in Death heal/percentHealth, R named Unstoppable Onslaught)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Twin Fangs' in mid; Sion's abilities were never named.
audit.why: Real names make the advice actionable and the fabricated plural is a known defect class here.
audit.corrected: Twin Fang singular; Decimating Smash, Soul Furnace, Roar of the Slayer, Unstoppable Onslaught and Glory in Death all named.

edits.before: Land a fully charged Q knockup to lock you in place, then E shield-break and W detonate onto your squishy frame for a kill trade
edits.after: Land a charged Decimating Smash to lock you up, then shred armour with Roar of the Slayer and detonate Soul Furnace on your squishy frame

edits.before: Pop his W shield to facetank a Twin Fang volley, then poke back with his ranged E shield-break to contest CS while the shield holds
edits.after: Pop Soul Furnace (15s) to facetank a Twin Fang volley, then poke back with Roar of the Slayer's armour shred while the shield holds

edits.before: Flank or engage with R from fog so he knocks you up before your Gaze comes up, since he loses the straight 1v1 every time
edits.after: Engage with Unstoppable Onslaught from fog — he is Unstoppable through it, so your Gaze cannot stop the charge, only Flash can

edits.before: Malignance or Liandry's online means your Q+E chip simply out-paces a tank with no Grievous Wounds and no sustain — he has no way to heal through the poison or trade your ramping DPS off him.
edits.after: Malignance or Liandry's out-paces his tank stats, but he is not sustain-free: Glory in Death heals him and hits off your max health, so armour and MR are the wrong answer — kill the zombie with distance.

edits.before: His only path to kill you is catching you out — a charged Q from fog or a long-range R engage that knocks you up before your Gaze comes online. Never get isolated in brush where his Q is already winding up.
edits.after: His only path to kill you is catching you out — a charged Decimating Smash from fog, or Unstoppable Onslaught, which your Gaze cannot stop; sidestep it or Flash the wall. Never facecheck brush holding a Q charge.

edits.before: Level 1 is your only soft spot — you have a single ability and no poison stacked, so don't walk up to a Sion holding a Q charge; just last-hit at range and respect the knockup. From level 2 this becomes your lane: drop Noxious Blast on his feet, let the poison tick, then weave Twin Fang for the refunded-cooldown nuke and peel off on your Q speed buff. He's a slow, immobile, single-target body — exactly what Twin Fang eats — and his ranged E shield-break poke can't out-trade your ramping DoT chip.
edits.after: Level 1 is your only soft spot — you have a single ability and no poison stacked, so don't walk up to a Sion holding a Decimating Smash charge; just last-hit at range and respect the knockup. From level 2 this becomes your lane: drop Noxious Blast on his feet, let the poison tick, then weave Twin Fang for the refunded-cooldown nuke and peel off on your Q speed buff. He's a slow, immobile, single-target body — exactly what Twin Fang eats — and Roar of the Slayer's 12s armour-shred poke can't out-trade your ramping DoT chip.

edits.before: This is your stomp window. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs on a primed Sion, and with no dash or blink he can't break line of sight or escape the poison cloud. Bait his W shield first — once it's down, prime with Q and unload E; don't dump the volley into a full shield. At 6, Petrifying Gaze flips his charged Q: keep facing him to stun the wind-up, or save it to execute the instant his shield expires. If he tries to walk you down, lay Miasma on top of him — the slow stacked on the poison turns his approach into a crawl while you kite on Q speed.
edits.after: This is your stomp window. Ranks in Q and E chain near-continuous Twin Fang casts on a primed Sion, and with no dash or blink he can't break line of sight or escape the poison cloud. Bait Soul Furnace first — it is 15s at rank 1, and a volley dumped into a full shield is wasted; prime with Q the moment it pops. At 6, Petrifying Gaze stuns his Decimating Smash wind-up if you keep facing him, but it will not stop Unstoppable Onslaught. If he walks you down, lay Miasma on him — slow stacked on poison turns his approach into a crawl while you kite on Q speed.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — Charged knockup — break the channel or sidestep the slam. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1, 6s maxed; sidestep the slam. - Soul Furnace is 15s: bait the shield, then commit. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - Do not bank R for his Unstoppable charge.
